spans.s: ण्डः, ण्डम् A round mass, ball, globe; as in अयःपिण्डः, नेत्रपिण्डः &c.
A round lump of food, morsel, mouthful; स न्यस्तशस्त्रो हरये स्वदेहमुपानयत् पिण्डमिवामिषस्य
A ball or lump of rice offered to the Manes at obsequial ceremonies or Śrāddhas; नूनं मत्तः परं वंश्याः पिण्डविच्छेददर्शिनः । न प्रकामभुजः श्राद्धे स्वधासंग्रहतत्पराः ।
. 'who was true to his master's salt'.
The fœtus or embryo in an early stage of gestation.
The body, corporeal frame; एकान्तविध्वंसिषु मद्विधानां पिण्डेष्वनास्था खलु भौतिकेषु
Anything round, thick, gross or solid.
A particular part of a house.
(In astr.) A sine expressed in numbers.
The twenty-fourth part of the quadrant of a circle.
The frontal sinus of an elephant or its projection.
A portico or shed in front of the door.
The flower of a China rose.
Water; L. D. B. -Comp -अक्षर a. containing a conjunct consonant. -अन्वाहार्यa. to be eaten after the funeral rice-ball has been offered to the manes; पिण्डान्वाहार्यकं श्राद्धं कुर्यान्मासानुमासिकम्

. -अन्वाहार्यकम् a meal in honour of the manes. -अभ्रम् hail. -अयसम् steel. -अलक्तकः a red dye. -अशनः, -आशः, -आशकः, -आशिन् m. a beggar.-उदकक्रिया an oblation of obsequial rice-balls and water to the deceased. -उद्धरणम् participating in funeral offerings. -गोसः gum myrrh. -तैलम्, -तैलकः incense. -द a.
one who gives food, one who supplies with bread or with any other means of subsistence; श्वा पिण्डदस्य कुरुते गजपुङ्गवस्तु धीरं विलोकयति चाटुशतैश्च भुङ्क्ते
one who is qualified to give the funeral rice-balls to deceased ancestors;
(दः) the nearest male relation who offers the funeral rice-ball.
दानम् presentation of the obsequial rice-balls.
the funeral oblation made to deceased ancestors on the day of new-moon. -निर्वपणम् presenting obsequial riceballs to the manes; अनयैवावृता कार्यं पिण्डनिर्वपणं सुतैः
. -निवृत्तिः cessation of relationship (by श्राद्ध oblation). -पदम् a particular अङ्कभेद in Astronomy; Śabda Chi. -पातः giving alms;
. -पातिकः one who lives on alms. -पादः, -पाद्यः an elephant. -पितृयज्ञः the oblation to deceased ancestors on the evening of new moon.
(पुष्पम्) the blossom of the Asoka tree.

a lotus.-भाज् a. receiving or entitled to a share in the funeral rice-ball. -m. (pl.) the deceased ancestors or manes; अहो दुष्यन्तस्य संशयमारूढाः पिण्डभाजः Ś.6. -भृतिः f. livelihood, means of subsistence. -मूलम्, -मूलकम् a carrot.-यज्ञः the presentation of the obsequial rice-balls to the deceased ancestors; पिण्डयज्ञावृता देयं प्रेतायान्नं दिनत्रयम्
. -लेपः fragments of the obsequial rice-balls which cling to the hand; (these are presented to the three ancestors immediately preceding the great-grand father).
लोपः interruption in offering the funeral rice-balls (as the failure of issue).
neglect in offering the funeral rice-balls (to the deceased ancestors). -विषमः one of the ways of embezzlement namely inconsistency in dealing with fixed items; Kau.

. -शर्करा sugar prepared from Yavanāla. -संबन्धः relationship between a living person and one deceased such as is sufficiently near to qualify the former to offer the obsequial rice-ball to the latter. -स्वेदः a hot poultice.
पिण्डकः [piṇḍakḥ] कम् [kam], कम् 1 A lump, ball, globe.
(In astr.) A sine expressed in numbers. -कः A goblin, demon.
पिण्डसः [piṇḍasḥ], A beggar, a mendicant living on alms.
पिण्डारः [piṇḍārḥ], 1 A religious mendicant or beggar.

A pedestal for the image of a deity. -Comp. -पुष्पः the Aśoka tree. -लेपः a kind of unguent. -शूरः 'brave in the house', or 'a cake-hero', a braggart, cowardly boaster, poltroon, cotquean; राक्षसान् बटुयज्ञेषु पिण्डीशूरान् निरस्तवान्
पिण्डिका [piṇḍikā], 1 A round or fleshy swelling.
The calf of the leg &c.; विकटोद्बद्धपिण्डिकम्
The region of the cheeks (गण्डस्थल); भिन्नमस्तकपिण्डिकाः
Pressed or rolled into a ball or lump.
'this is the meaning on the whole'.
Mixed with; न समा मम वीर्यस्य शतांशेनापि पिण्डिताः
One who offers funeral rice-balls to the manes.
An astronomer, a calculator of nativities.
To make into a lump, press together, unite.
पिण्डीभू [piṇḍībhū], 1 P. To be made into a ball or lump, become solid.
पिण्डीर [piṇḍīra], a. Sapless, insipid, arid, dry.
Foam of the sea; cf. डिण्डीर.
पिण्डोलिः [piṇḍōliḥ], f. Fragments dropped from the mouth, offal, leavings of a meal.
To roll into a lump or ball, put together.
पिण्याकः [piṇyākḥ] कम् [kam], कम् 1 Oil-cake; कणान् वा भक्षयेदब्दं पिण्याकं वा सकृन्निशि
Residue of seeds ground for oil; श्रेयस्तैलं च पिण्याकात्
